llms.intro: Lenticule Science is the research company of the 561 Group. It develops Relationality and Obsmetrologia into research on causality, information, quantum foundations, formal mathematics and a living Web. Its relational physics series supplies explicit constructions, finite calculations, source references and open physical questions. Other publications cover four-valued logic, concurrent agents, machine-payable markets and organizational science.
